description: Expansion module with 10 digital inputs, 6 NTC and 2 analog inputs and 10 relay outputs, Modbus RTU version
source: Mercato Módulo de Expansão ME22A - Manual de Serviço, Revision G, 2016-07-06

sources.title: Módulo de Expansão ME22A - Manual de Serviço

notes: The module comes in a Modbus RTU or a BACnet version. Address and speed are set with the ME22A Config software in the first 5 seconds after power-on; the manual gives no factory values, so 9600 bit/s, 8 data bits, no parity and address 1 are assumed.
The manual does not give the Modbus function codes; the registers are read here as holding registers.
FLOAT and 32-bit values have the high word first.
The manual marks the clock setting registers 600 to 606 as read only, while their descriptions say they set the clock; they are writable here.
The 32-bit alarm word at registers 300 and 301 is listed bit by bit: bits 0 to 15 are in register 301, bits 16 to 18 in register 300.
The meaning of each bit of the schedule day mask is not given.
Written from the manufacturer's manual; not tested on a device.
